name: Stephen Milton Gill
notable_stories: His obituary praised him as a highly intelligent, noble, affectionate young man, a loving son and brother, whose death was a blow to his aged parents and many friends.
milestones: Died 28 May 1889, Union Township, Licking County, Ohio
Funeral from his home in Union Township, interment in Cedar Hill Cemetery
Obituary describes him as a true Christian
sources: Further Research on the Family and Descendants of Joseph P. and Elizabeth (Hamilton) Adams, William W. Allen (February 2012)
notes: Died early, at age forty, never having married [Further Research, line 8598]
